about: Evidence-verified destination access for Legon. An entry here overrides the automatic evidence chain in scripts/geography/build-access.mjs and must say why. Entrances are an OSM node or gate, a point measured on the georeferenced reference atlas ('at', snapped onto the named footprint), the side of a footprint met by a mapped axis or facing a direction, or where a mapped way meets the footprint, or the middle of the facade facing (or, for a back entrance, turned away from) another destination ('faces', 'awayFrom'). 'status': verified (direct visual or written evidence of the entrance), partial (evidence for the side/approach but not the exact door), unverified (listed in 'priority' with no entry here: the automatic result is kept and reported, never presented as verified). 'refs' name the user-supplied reference images (UG_BUILDINGS__LAYOUTS_AND_THEIR_STRUCTURES.zip and the two satellite atlas sheets) used as evidence; coordinates are game-frame metres measured on those images after registering them to the OSM footprints (docs/LEGON_ENTRANCE_VERIFICATION.md).

citations.user-atlas: Satellite campus reference atlas supplied by the project owner (2 sheets, Apple Maps imagery), registered to OSM footprints
citations.user-layouts: UG_BUILDINGS__LAYOUTS_AND_THEIR_STRUCTURES.zip supplied by the project owner: labelled layouts and entrance photos
citations.user-photos: Photos of the four Diaspora halls supplied by the project owner (an aerial of all four halls, a drone view of one hall's front and courtyard, two oblique drone views of the facades, a close view of the entrance pavilion), with the owner's description of how the halls face each other
citations.user-photos-jubilee-ish: Photos supplied by the project owner of Jubilee Hall (aerial of the entrance corner, courtyard) and the International Students Hostel (entrance facade), and a satellite layout of Jubilee Hall, ISH 1 and ISH 2 with the entrances and car parks marked, registered to the OSM footprints (2.8 px/m, 1° rotation)

campusGates.name: Main Gate
campusGates.access: vehicles with a UG permit; pedestrians and cyclists
campusGates.evidence: Written: 'the Main gate (opposite the Legon Police Station)'. OSM: two permit lift gates across Dr. J.B. Danquah Avenue at the gatehouse, 175 m west of the police station across the N4.

campusGates.name: North Gate
campusGates.evidence: Written: 'the North gate (close to the James Topp-Nelson Yankah Hall, Haatso Road)'. OSM: two permit lift gates 100 m north-west of the hall on the road to the Haatso road.

campusGates.name: Link Gate
campusGates.evidence: Written: 'the Link Gate' from the Achimota-Legon road. OSM: permit lift gates on the tertiary road beside the road named 'Link Gate'.

campusGates.name: Okponglo (Stadium Road) entrance
campusGates.access: open to the public 24 hours (2014 directive)
campusGates.evidence: Written: 'the Stadium Road entrance at the Okponglo intersection ... remains open 24 hours to the general public'; a security access gate building was commissioned on the road near the stadium. OSM: a public lift gate and a permissive swing gate on the road from the Okponglo junction past the stadium.

campusGates.name: South Gate
campusGates.evidence: Written: 'the South gate (from Noguchi Memorial Institute for Medical Research to National Highway 4)'. OSM: a permit gate on the road running east from the Noguchi area to the N4. Which of the two permit gates in the south-east is the named South Gate is not stated; this is the one on the Noguchi road.

destinations.approach: From the N4 (J.J. Rawlings Avenue) turn west into Dr. J.B. Danquah Avenue and pass the inbound lift gate at the gatehouse.
destinations.evidence: UG security directive: 'the Main gate (opposite the Legon Police Station)'; OSM permit lift gates at the gatehouse on the inbound carriageway; reference atlas shows the gatehouse straddling the avenue.

destinations.approach: Along the avenue to the fountain roundabout, then north up the forecourt lanes to the library's south front.
destinations.evidence: UG: the fountain on the University Square 'overlooking the Balme Library'. Reference atlas (sheet 2): a paved forecourt runs on the fountain axis from the roundabout to the library's south facade; OSM forecourt lanes (ways 448104199, 448104193) frame it. The north side faces the Kuffour Quadrangle gardens.

destinations.approach: Up Legon Hill on the axial road from the east, stop at its turning loop, then cross the Convocation courtyard west to the hall's east front.
destinations.evidence: great_hall_and_directorate_4: the public front is the gable end with three doors at the end of a long paved courtyard with lawn panels between low flanking wings, the tower beside it. great_hall_and_directorate_3: the opposite (west) end is the curved, terraced end above the loop road. Reference atlas sheet 2: the paved courtyard lies east of the hall, between it and the axial road loop (OSM way 424526319). Previous entrance (west side, at the turning circles) was the back of the hall.

secondary.label: west turning circles (service / back of the hall)
secondary.evidence: OSM turning circles on the summit loop at the curved west end

destinations.approach: Ride onto the square's paths and stop in the middle of the square, between the library front and the fountain.
destinations.evidence: UG text: 'mid-way [along the avenue] is an open space, the University Square, with an ornamental fountain'. The square's outline is derived from the lanes that bound it (no source maps it).

destinations.approach: Viewed and reached from the University Square's south edge; the fountain sits on the avenue roundabout island.
destinations.evidence: OSM fountain polygon (way 320067568) inside the avenue roundabout; the square lies directly north of it.

destinations.approach: Up Legon Hill to the service road south of the Convocation Group and its car park.
destinations.evidence: OSM 'University of Ghana Registry' node lies inside this building (OSM names it 'Cash office'); Apple's 'University of Ghana Registry' label in reference atlas sheet 2 sits on the same block; OSM car park (way 720486435) and service road (way 720486437) adjoin its south side. Exact door not visible.

destinations.approach: Behind (north of) the Balme Library; enter the formal garden from its south edge on the central path.
destinations.evidence: Radio Univers: 'Balme Library Gardens / Kuffuor Quadrangle', behind the library. Atlas sheet 2 shows the symmetric formal garden with its central axis aligned on the library.

destinations.approach: Into the Banking Square car park on the north side of the bank courtyard building.
destinations.evidence: banking_square_layout: the bank courtyard building (Prudential Bank) with its customer car park along the north facade and access road; OSM car park 'Banking Square Parking'. Individual bank doors are not visible.

destinations.approach: From the Banking Square side, into the north end of the stall rows.
destinations.evidence: Reference atlas sheet 1: the market is the angled rows of stall sheds south of the bank courtyard (OSM food court way 773864855); the rows open toward the Banking Square car park at their north end.

destinations.approach: Along the avenue's southern carriageway, turn into the paved forecourt on the hall's axis and stop at the north front.
destinations.evidence: Business listings place the Legon Hall Porters Lodge on J. B. Danquah Road (the avenue). legon_hall_layout (registered to OSM): the hall's spine footway (OSM 1186587902/614159986) runs north to this block; atlas sheet 2 shows a paved forecourt from the avenue to its north face. legon_hall_entrance photo: arched front with a paved forecourt. Note: Apple's 'Legon Hall' pin sits on OSM 'Maison Francais' to the east, which is a different building.

secondary.label: Legon Hall Southern Gate
secondary.evidence: Apple label 'Legon Hall Southern Gate' in legon_hall_layout

destinations.approach: Off the avenue's southern carriageway onto the forecourt footway, to the arched gatehouse that leads into the fountain court.
destinations.evidence: akuafo_hall_layout (registered to OSM): the forecourt footway (OSM 606687250 / 603522802) leaves the avenue and passes through the arch of this north block into the circular fountain court; akuafo_hall_entrance: stone-paved forecourt with curved paths and circular planters at the entrance. Previous entrance was an inferred point on the service road east of the hall.

destinations.approach: Along Mensah Sarbah Crescent into the semicircular drive in front of the porters' lodge archway.
destinations.evidence: mensah_sarbah_hall_main_2 (aerial): the gate building with its central archway faces a semicircular drive; mensah_sarbah_hall_layout (registered): that drive is OSM way 1540994843 and the gate building is OSM 'Administration and Porters' Lodge' (way 300288063). The large block with the cupola in main_1/main_3 is across the courtyard (the dining hall), not the entrance.

destinations.approach: Along Volta Hall Road into the semicircular drop-off loop in front of the east wing.
destinations.evidence: volta_hall_layout (registered to OSM): OSM maps a semicircular drop-off loop (way 1535119978) off Volta Hall Road directly in front of the east wing; volta_hall_entrance: an arched doorway at the top of a flight of steps up from a drive. The photo cannot be tied to the loop with certainty.

destinations.approach: Up the avenue to its western end at the hall.
destinations.evidence: UG: 'the University Avenue extends to Commonwealth Hall on Legon Hill'. commonwealth_hall_entrance_1-3: a porch at the top of wide steps from a drive where cars park. The oblique layout photos are not north-up, so which end they show cannot be fixed; the east end on the avenue axis is kept.

destinations.approach: Into the car park between Sey and JNA; the front entrance is the gabled pavilion in the middle of the facade facing JNA.
destinations.evidence: Owner: the four Diaspora halls are one design and are built in facing pairs (Limann and Kwapong, Sey and Jean Nelson); each pair's front entrances face each other across their car parks. Owner photos: the front entrance is a projecting gabled pavilion at the centre of the long facade (tall arched window above a columned porch), on the axis of the car park; the aerial of all four halls shows the facing fronts on one axis with a walkway between them.

secondary.label: back entrance (no car park)
secondary.evidence: Owner: every hall also has a back entrance, without a car park. Owner photos: the same gabled pavilion sits at the centre of the opposite long facade.

destinations.evidence: Owner: the four Diaspora halls are one design and are built in facing pairs (Limann and Kwapong, Sey and Jean Nelson); each pair's front entrances face each other across their car parks. Limann is the first of the four halls on the way in from Jubilee Link. Owner photos: the front entrance is a projecting gabled pavilion at the centre of the long facade (tall arched window above a columned porch), on the axis of the car park; the aerial of all four halls shows the facing fronts on one axis with a walkway between them.

destinations.approach: From the car park east of the hall to the entrance in the south-east corner, beside the white entrance block with the round tower.
destinations.evidence: Owner's marked layout (registered to OSM): the entrance is in the re-entrant corner at the hall's south-east end (the notch in OSM relation 3697984), beside the car park between Jubilee and ISH 1. Owner's aerial photo: the entrance block there, white with a flat roof, a round white tower, a portico and water tanks. Earlier evidence (jubilee_hall_4, jubilee_hall_layout) puts the porch at the same corner.
refs: jubilee_ish_layout (owner satellite layout with entrances and car parks marked)

destinations.approach: Up the straight access road from the south that ends at the school's forecourt.
destinations.evidence: engineering_school_layout (registered to OSM): a straight access road from the south ends at a paved forecourt in front of the south block, where Apple pins 'School of Engineering Sciences'; the car park is to the west.

destinations.approach: From the road north of the school, through its car park to the covered walkway along the north front.
destinations.evidence: business_school_layout (registered to OSM): the car park and access road lie along the north side, with a covered walkway on the north facade. Door not visible.

destinations.approach: From the avenue side by the footpaths that converge on the building's south front.
destinations.evidence: Radio Univers: JQB is 'close to the Main Entrance ... behind the Institute of African Studies, on your right side when coming from the main gate'. Atlas sheet 2 + OSM: the footpaths from the avenue side converge on the south face. Previous entrance was an inferred point at the north-east corner (the back).

destinations.approach: From the road on the east into the paved courtyard enclosed by the law buildings.
destinations.evidence: law_school_layout (registered to OSM): the buildings wrap a paved courtyard that opens to the road on the east (a vehicle is parked in it).

destinations.approach: From the road west of the stadium to the main (west) grandstand.
destinations.evidence: Atlas sheet 1: the covered main grandstand is on the west side of the bowl, facing the road and the gym centre. Spectator gates are not mapped.

destinations.approach: From the road along the south side, facing the Central Cafeteria.
destinations.evidence: athletic_oval_labeled: paths enter the oval at its south end; Radio Univers: the CC is 'opposite Athletic Oval' (CC lies to the south).

destinations.approach: From the road between the CC and Mensah Sarbah Hall.
destinations.evidence: Radio Univers: CC is 'right in front of Mensah Sarbah Hall and opposite Athletic Oval' (Sarbah lies south). Door not visible.

destinations.approach: From the car park between Jubilee Hall and ISH 1 to the gabled porch on the hostel's north facade.
destinations.evidence: Owner's marked layout (registered to OSM): the entrance is on ISH 1's north facade, a little east of its middle, facing the car park it shares with Jubilee Hall. Owner photo of the hostel: a small gabled porch on the long four-storey facade, behind the car park, a little off-centre.
refs: jubilee_ish_layout (owner satellite layout with entrances and car parks marked)

destinations.approach: From the Haatso-Atomic road side into the gardens' main entrance.
destinations.evidence: OSM entrance=main (node 2248903579) on the gardens' boundary; Visit Ghana: the gardens are 'off Atomic Haatso Main Road at Agbogba Junction'.

destinations.approach: From the car park between ISH 2 and Jubilee Hall to the entrance canopy on the hostel's south facade.
destinations.evidence: Owner's marked layout (registered to OSM): the entrance is on ISH 2's south facade, east of its middle, at the corner of the car park between ISH 2 and Jubilee Hall. Owner: ISH 2 has the same structure as ISH 1. international_students_hostel_1: the balconied facade with a flat entrance canopy and a car park in front.
refs: jubilee_ish_layout (owner satellite layout with entrances and car parks marked)
